note: Proto defines the transmission format; Rust bindings parse and format symbols; scip CLI lints, prints, snapshots, stats
Rust binding writes messages to a file; README lists indexers that emit SCIP (rust-analyzer, scip-typescript, scip-python, others)
SymbolInformation carries documentation, signature, kind, enclosing symbol and relationships; no summaries
Not an IR for agents: DESIGN.md calls it a transmission format, not a storage or efficient navigation format
Code modification is an explicit non-goal in DESIGN.md
Package manager, name and version in each Symbol plus external_symbols allow cross-repo links; no sharing runtime
Metadata has project_root, tool_info, encoding; no commit or revision field. Document.text and position_encoding pin offsets
DESIGN.md lists file-level incrementality as a producer goal; schema is per Document so partial reindex is possible
